hooks: Embrace your weakness, not hide it.
Surrendering isn't giving up, it's trusting.
God’s strength is found in our weaknesses.
Pray with honesty, not just for show.
When your strength fades, His shines brighter.
Weakness is the gateway to His power.

poster.headline: God’s Strength Through Our Weakness
poster.subheadline: Embrace Your Vulnerability for His Power

posts.headline: Let Go of Pretense: Embrace Your True Self
posts.caption: God doesn’t need us to pretend. Let your true self shine, and see His strength in you.

posts.headline: Honest Prayer: The Key to His Power
posts.caption: Pray with sincerity, and watch His power transform your life.
